concept_uz: Qirol Noʻl qaror qiladi: ratsional ham, irratsional ham — haqiqiy sonlar. Ikki xalq birlashib, Haqiqiy sonlar imperiyasiga asos soladi; oʻqda birorta teshik qolmaydi. Katta toʻy: Uch kuylaydi, egizaklar yana gʻoyib boʻladi. Yarim tunda oʻqning ustidan ovoz keladi: «Men √(−1)man…»
style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, gentle split light — cool moonlight from the left, warm sunlight from the right — soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round king shaped like a thick, chunky upright ring with a small hole in the middle, so its wide front face is a disc. The ring is coloured like a yin-yang: the left half dark moon-silver with one small bright gold dot, the right half bright sun-gold with one small dark silver dot, the two halves curving into each other in a smooth S-shaped wave — made of polished metal, not a flat printed symbol. Big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast low-poly crystal plain, exactly where the cool left side meets the warm right side, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A slim upright sun-gold character shaped like a tall narrow pillar with a small slanted flag-like tip at the top, big cheerful eyes, a wide smile, thin cartoon arms and legs, and a small round badge with a plus sign pinned on its chest. It stands on the vast low-poly crystal plain, front view, centred.

Change this character: exactly the same shape, size and face, but made of shining moon-silver instead of gold, eyebrows lowered in a grumpy frown, arms crossed, and a horizontal dark-blue sash wrapped across its middle instead of the plus badge. Same plain, same framing, full body, front view.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty low-poly crystal plain made of smooth faceted triangular polygons: cool lavender-blue facets on the left, warm amber facets on the right, blending softly in the middle. A thin glowing straight path runs across the ground from left to right through the centre. The sky is split the same gentle way: soft twilight indigo with a few stars on the left, where a pale moon with a gentle old woman's face smiles; warm morning light on the right, where a big warm sun with a kind old grandfather's face — smiling eyes, bushy eyebrows and a beard of rays — smiles back. Not dark, just a gentle difference between the two sides. No characters.

Vertical 9:16. The king's long wooden staff lying flat on the low-poly crystal plain from left to right, with evenly spaced carved notches along it, the middle notch glowing gold. Low camera angle along the staff, morning light, no characters.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A chubby, energetic purple character shaped like a curvy rounded number-three shape with two bulges, big excited eyes, open mouth mid-speech, wearing a shiny wedding-host jacket and holding a golden microphone. Crystal plain with festive lanterns, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A tall, thoughtful teal character with a graceful swan-like curved neck and a flat base, gentle sad eyes, standing inside a glass cage whose front edge is shaped like a large tick-mark with a long roof (the square-root sign). Moody evening light on the low-poly crystal plain, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. An elderly scholar character with a round kind face, small spectacles and a long white beard, wearing a deep-blue chapan robe covered in a pattern of circles, holding a coil of measuring rope. He stands beside a wooden cart wheel on the low-poly crystal plain, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A lively bazaar merchant character with a curled moustache and a bright embroidered doppi cap, grinning, holding a leather coin purse that is visibly swelling and bulging with gold coins. A colourful market stall on the low-poly crystal plain behind him, front view, centred.

A grand evening feast along the glowing notched staff on the low-poly crystal plain: long tables, huge pots of plov, lanterns, and many number-characters celebrating together, the purple microphone character and the merchant among them. Keep their designs exactly the same. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.prompt: Dawn over the crystal plain; two crowds gather from the left and the right toward the yin-yang ring-king standing at the centre. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, deep, velvety storyteller's voice, slow and mysterious like an old radio fairy tale: "Va nihoyat, katta qaror kuni yetib kelibdi…" Lip-sync: nobody on screen speaks — the narrator is heard off screen and every mouth stays closed. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Va nihoyat, katta qaror kuni yetib kelibdi…

scenes.prompt: On the palace square the ring-king faces two crowds — the bright fraction folk on one side and the caged characters with the scholar on the other — and says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, slightly theatrical baritone voice of a kind middle-aged king, slow, with dramatic pauses: "Siz ikkalangiz ham haqiqiysiz!" Lip-sync: only the yin-yang ring-king moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Both crowds erupt in cheers; the caged teal character proudly lifts its cage high for the first time. The scholar begins, says in Uzbek with a slow, sleepy, creaky voice of an elderly professor: "Rahmat… uch butun, bir, to'rt…" and everyone gently, laughingly, puts their hands over his mouth. Lip-sync: only the elderly scholar in the circle-patterned robe moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Along the whole staff every tiny dark gap fills with light, one after another, until the line glows without a single hole from horizon to horizon. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, deep, velvety storyteller's voice, slow and mysterious like an old radio fairy tale: "Haqiqiy sonlar imperiyasi tug'ildi." Lip-sync: nobody on screen speaks — the narrator is heard off screen and every mouth stays closed. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

At the feast the merchant leans over the plov pot with his purse and says in Uzbek with a quick, smooth, smiling voice of a bazaar trader: "Oshning narxi, foiz ustiga foiz…" Two guards politely lift him by the arms and carry him to the far end of the table. Lip-sync: only the merchant with the swelling purse moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The purple character grabs the microphone again — and this time the whole feast sings along, swaying with raised cups: everyone says in Uzbek with a crowd of cheerful mixed voices in unison: "Uch, uch, uch!" Lip-sync: only the whole crowd, together moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The gold and silver twins, overjoyed, hug each other — POP — they vanish. The whole table bursts out laughing and shouts, says in Uzbek with a crowd of cheerful mixed voices in unison: "Yana-ya?!" Lip-sync: only the whole crowd, together moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Midnight. The ring-king stands alone at the centre of the glowing line under a sky full of stars, smiling peacefully, and says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, slightly theatrical baritone voice of a kind middle-aged king, slow, with dramatic pauses: "Hammaga joy bor." Lip-sync: only the yin-yang ring-king moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Above the line, high in the air where nothing should be, a tiny glowing violet figure floats down and says in Uzbek with a tiny, shy, echoing child's voice: "Kechirasiz… men ildiz ostida minus birman. Meni ham qabul qilasizlarmi?" The king jumps, his crown flying off, and stares up. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, deep, velvety storyteller's voice, slow and mysterious like an old radio fairy tale: "Birinchi mavsum tugadi. Davomi — powerty.uz da." Lip-sync: nobody on screen speaks — the tiny voice from above and the narrator is heard off screen and every mouth stays closed. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Kechirasiz… men ildiz ostida minus birman. Meni ham qabul qilasizlarmi?
Birinchi mavsum tugadi. Davomi — powerty.uz da.
